comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Whoops, I knew that. Guess I copied the wrong link? Correcting my error now... This item can be produced via Transmutation Alchemy. Requires:

Base Item: Seal of Sylph
Ingredients: Rare Books x20 + Crystal x20
Rank 3 Alchemy + Handicrafts skills
Completion of the "Egypt & Atlantis" story quest from the Atlantis chain to unlock Transmutation Alchemy + Transmutation Alchemy furniture -- either Transmutation Alchemy Equipment or Complex Alchemy Equipment

Effect: on using this item, it allows you to return you to your Quarters from port city in the world.

What you can do: Friends can visit. You can move furniture, pets and mannequins, changing the latter's equipment if you wish. You can withdraw/deposit consumables/documents/ship parts/equipment. You can swap aides, change stewards, add/remove ornaments, and even do alchemy recipes.
What you can't do: deposit/withdraw trade goods from regular quarters/aide production storage, open a bazaar, exchange with other characters who may visit, or buy from their bazaars.

When you finally leave your quarters (or log out/get disconnected), you automatically return to wherever you used the item. This item can also randomly be obtained from Purchase Request Ticket (No.3) as well.

Hope that helps. Cheers. And thanks for the correction, Wsp.
